adapter.rate_note: No numeric limit on the pages read; JSON-RPC overview: 'Unauthenticated HTTP requests have stricter rate limits' and error 10028 too_many_requests means 'Allowed request rate has been exceeded' (https://docs.deribit.com/articles/errors). Two requests per second.

me.note: Public API, no credentials: the probe is GET /public/test ({jsonrpc, id, result.version}).

search_symbols.note: get_instruments has no text search: `query` is sent as the REQUIRED `currency` parameter (BTC, ETH, USDC, USDT, EURR or any) and every non-expired instrument of that currency comes back in one response (kind future/option/spot/…; expired=false default; no pagination, `page`/`limit` ignored). `type` is the instrument kind; base_currency, quote_currency, is_active, expiration_timestamp, strike, option_type, tick_size, contract_size stay in `raw`. JSON-RPC errors arrive as {error: {code, message}} — 10028 is the rate limit.

not_offered.get_candles: public/get_tradingview_chart_data (instrument_name, start_timestamp, end_timestamp in ms, resolution) returns parallel arrays result.ticks[]/open[]/high[]/low[]/close[]/volume[] rather than one record per candle; the runtime cannot zip parallel arrays.
not_offered.get_series: public/get_funding_rate_history and get_historical_volatility need integer-millisecond timestamps and return positional/parallel rows; not mappable by the runtime.
not_offered.get_news: No news endpoint on this API.
